D-02.title: Cashier Counter D-02
D-02.note:
Made as 2 units: D-02 counter 700 x 1200
+ D-02-F display fridge 700 x 900, top +1.000.
D-02: SHS 40x40x2 frame on 4 adjustable feet
as E-C1. Inside all stainless 304 brushed 1.2.
Customer face and south end FR MDF 18

Power + data by MEP. Fridge by others.

CF-1.title: Ceiling Wood Frame, Mesh and Flowers
CF-1.note:
Centre ceiling, all hung from ONE steel frame.
STEEL FRAME: SHS 40x40x2 grid on the rattan
board (+3.2125): ring 2320 x 1670, 2 cross
members, 1 middle member, welded.
ALL STEEL PAINTED BLACK (rods, nuts, cleats,
flat bars, SHS, mesh): no galvanising, no
powder coat.
HANGERS: threaded rods only: 10 M10 rods,
drop-in anchors in the slab soffit +3.70, to
angle cleats 40x40x4 welded to the ring, nut +
washer each side (level on the nuts).
No diagonal bracing.
WOOD FRAME: U open at the top, 18 FR MDF
oak veneer to match EGGER H1145 ST10, all
edges 45, glue blocks @ 600. Hung on 10 flat
bars FB 40x5 welded to the SHS, through slots in
the board. Fixing only: 2 screws 4.8x30 through a 6 ply
packer into the box inner side (hidden).
LEVELLING: on the M10 rod nuts only.
Shift <=100 to clear downlights GL-1..8.
RATTAN PANEL (centre field): 8 FR MDF oak
veneer, 2 sheets, joint on the middle member,
screwed up into the SHS @ 300, rattan weave
pasted under it. Underside +3.2015.
MESH: welded 4 wire @ 100, painted black,
top +3.140 (~60 gap under the rattan panel
to tie the plants), on 25x25x3 angles screwed
to the frame; 2 bars FB 40x5 on top of the
mesh, on 4 M8 rods (25x25x3 cleats) to the
SHS.
FLOWERS: by florist, FR artificial
bougainvillea tied to the mesh, outline only,
lowest tip +2.400. ~115 kg total.
